bundle.shortDescription: Filament SDS/TDS PDF -> tailored Snapmaker_Orca profile
bundle.longDescription: Reads a manufacturer Safety or Technical Data Sheet PDF, extracts the relevant chemistry and printing parameters, and creates a Snapmaker_Orca filament profile tailored to the specific filament — ready to import. Companion app to LeanSpectrum.
